topic: Training AI on AI-Generated Text Causes Model Collapse
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

AI can go insane if it only learns from itself! This mind-blowing concept is called 'model collapse.'

Here's why it matters:
🔹 When AI trains on its own synthetic outputs, it loses crucial data diversity.
🔹 This causes the model to 'forget' how to generate complex, creative, and human-like text.
🔹 The result? The AI permanently degenerates into predictable, bland, and ultimately useless gibberish.
